title: Layers of technology in pluriversal design. Decolonising language technology with the LiveLanguage initiative

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation of path dependencies in traditional Anglo-centric data models (e.g., Princeton WordNet) and architectural evaluation of the Universal Knowledge Core (UKC), a concept-based lexical database that directly translates across over 2,000 languages to identify lexical gaps without defaulting to English as the pivot language.

Theoretical framework analysis using a five-layer model of technological activity to examine how language technologies enforce Western epistemologies and neocolonial power structures, advocating for pluriversal co-design and value-sensitive interventions to support minority and indigenous knowledge ecologies.
